institution: IIIT Manipur (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Manipur)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data, spanning 2019-2024)

key_positive_themes.notes: Recent reviews report near-universal placement for many students; highest package 46 LPA, average around 12 LPA, lowest 8 LPA; top recruiters include Amazon, Jio, Infosys, and Publicis Sapient — a dramatic improvement from 2019 when no companies visited campus.
Curriculum regularly updated to match IIIT and industry standards; large library with over 10,000 books; supportive and well-qualified faculty in recent reviews.
WiFi accessibility in every classroom, smart board facilities, hygienic and clean food — a marked improvement from earlier reports of basic whiteboards and limited labs.
Rated 4.3/5; being an IIIT is seen as offering strong value compared to private colleges and GFTIs claiming similar placement stats.
Students describe a dynamic campus life with tech fests and events; hostel life described as a unique, memorable experience.

key_negative_themes.notes: IIIT Manipur currently operates from a transit campus in Mantripukhri, Imphal (opposite the Software Technology Park), rather than a dedicated permanent campus.

Early reviews from 2019 described no placement record at all, faculty issues, only four functional labs (with one under construction), and average canteen food — reflecting the institute's very early stage.
Placements are noted as being strongest in IT and ECE branches, implying other branches may see comparatively fewer opportunities.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Dynamic campus life with strong academics and community — good infrastructure including academic building, libraries, hostels, computer labs, sports facilities
A decent college — good campus, hostel facilities for both genders, wifi, library, recent tech fest organized, placements decent especially IT and ECE
Highest salary offered is 46 LPA, average about 12 LPA, lowest 8 LPA; top recruiters Amazon, Jio, Infosys, Publicis Sapient
Honest review (2019): no placement record until now, none of the companies visited campus, infrastructure not that good, faculty an issue
Being an IIIT itself makes it great value for money among GFTIs and private colleges claiming better placement stats

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Manipur has improved dramatically over time, evolving from a rocky start in 2019 — with no placements and basic facilities — to a strongly positive standing today, with excellent recent placement figures (up to 46 LPA) and much-improved infrastructure and academics. The institute still operates from a transit campus rather than a dedicated permanent one, and placement strength appears to vary somewhat by branch, but overall trajectory and current sentiment are clearly positive.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) spanning multiple years as of the search date, and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study. Sentiment reflects a mix of both older (2019) and more recent (2024) reviews to capture the institute's growth trajectory.
